title: PrintReceiptRequest
description: Op 4 request: print a fiscal receipt. Encrypted with the session key.

dep.description: Department for simple/prepayment receipts (when `items` is empty).

partnerTin.description:
Partner TIN (8 digits) for B2B receipts. Sent as `null` if absent — the spec requires
this field to appear even when null.

useExtPOS.description:
If `true`, supply `rrn` + `terminal_id` from an external POS terminal. If `false`, the
HDM uses its own configured payment system (set `payment_system`).

PaymentSystem.description:
Payment system code from spec §4.8 (1 = card, 10-18 = various Armenian wallets). Used
only when `use_ext_pos = false` and the HDM has multiple payment systems configured.

rrn.description: Acquirer transaction RRN (12 chars). Used when `use_ext_pos = true`.

terminalId.description: Payment terminal unique ID (8 chars). Used when `use_ext_pos = true`.

eMarks.description:
eMark traceability codes for marked goods (29-110 chars each, ASCII printable, escaping
rules in spec §4.5.4). Used only in product-mode receipts.

items.description: Items (required when `mode = Products`). Use an empty `Vec` for simple/prepayment modes.

ReceiptItem.description: A single item in a printed receipt.

productCode.description: Vendor SKU (≤50 chars, must be non-empty).

productName.description: Display name (≤50 chars, must be non-empty).

adgCode.description:
ATG/ADG tax classification code. Lookup at `taxservice.am`. Mandatory unless waived by
item-level discount logic per spec §4.5.4.

unit.description: Unit of measure (≤50 chars, must be non-empty).

discount.description: Primary discount amount (skip when no discount applies).

discountType.description: Primary discount kind (skip when no discount applies).

additionalDiscount.description: Stacked secondary discount amount (skip when no discount applies).

additionalDiscountType.description: Stacked secondary discount kind (skip when no discount applies).
